verdict.rationale: PayPal offers OAuth-based REST API access and a Payouts API for sending money to multiple recipients, plus an Agent Toolkit that lets AI agents call PayPal APIs via function calling — these provide the building blocks an agent could use. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated balance-transaction/reporting endpoint or any documented reconciliation workflow tying payouts to underlying charges. missing for 10: balance-transaction/reporting API documentation, explicit reconciliation feature or example, independent confirmation that an agent can perform this workflow end-to-end.
